description: Add a tag to a forum's tag list. Moderated tags can only be applied by people with Manage Threads.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

moderated.description: If true, only members with Manage Threads can put this tag on a post. Default false.

name.description: The tag's name, up to 20 characters.

name: create_forum_tag
title: Create forum tag
